verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer-built, event-driven building blocks. Outgoing Webhooks send channel messages to a web service, bots can initiate and join conversations, and Graph lets external services automate Teams scenarios, such as creating a team when a business issue arises. None of this shows a user-facing way to define trigger→action rules; you have to write and host code yourself. missing for 10: a native rule/workflow builder (event triggers with conditions and actions), documentation of event types and subscriptions, a no-code automation path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
